name: Spindle Vex
source_profile: ● Spindle Vex (LE) is the Mob's principal quartermaster and organizer. Spindle attempts to impose discipline upon the raiders, arguing that regular tribute and carefully planned robberies would be more profitable than Kreech's unpredictable violence. He privately covets the Redcap mantle and believes that under his leadership the Mob could become a considerably more powerful organization.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 53 (source excerpt; may be partial)
